With a place in the 2011 Rugby World Cup final on the line, the Australia v New Zealand semi-final fixture was always going to be a good one
Competing at Eden Park, Auckland, the All Blacks were extra determined to secure their place in the final for the home crowd, as they took the win 20-6 against the Wallabies in a game to remember.
